name: Lukas Geyer
tagline: Short fiction, longform notes, and development dispatches for Semestra.
intro: I write stories and build thoughtful software for iOS. This is a quiet place for longform fiction, essays on craft, and release notes for Semestra—a smart study planner for students.

newsletter.heading: Letters & New Stories
newsletter.description: Receive new short stories, longform essays, and occasional Semestra release notes by email.
newsletter.footnote: Sent only when something new is published. Unsubscribe anytime.

semestra.name: Semestra
semestra.subtitle: Smart Study Planner for iPhone, iPad & Mac
semestra.summary: Semestra turns university timetables and syllabi into calm, adaptive study schedules—recalculating automatically when lectures shift and keeping exams within reach.

paradeiser.name: Paradeiser
paradeiser.subtitle: Calm Interval Focus Timer for iPhone & iPad
paradeiser.summary: Paradeiser is a quiet, tactile interval timer for deep work and study—set custom focus blocks and breaks (like 3 × 45 min with 15 min breaks in between), follow along on your Lock Screen, and track when and how long you focus.

muninn.name: Muninn
muninn.subtitle: Spaced-Repetition Flashcards Built on Rust & FSRS-7
muninn.summary: A spaced-repetition flashcard app as capable as Anki without being a clone of it: one shared Rust core with an FSRS-7 scheduler and lossless Anki deck import, wrapped in fast native apps starting with iOS and macOS.
muninn.pricing: Free on every platform · Optional Plus tier
